klipler.istem: The hand slowly reaches down toward the fly, the fly rubs its front legs together then stays still. Static camera, gentle natural motion only, same shape, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears. Exactly six legs, five fingers on the hand.
The film strip rushes past quickly in a smooth curve, frames flickering by. Static camera, gentle natural motion only, same shape, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
Slow push-in toward the compound eyes, light shimmers across the tiny facets. Static camera, gentle natural motion only, same shape, 3D animation style preserved, nothing new appears.
